{{Quote|I am a ghost.|Kell Douro|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
'''Kell Douro''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and [[Spy/Legends|spy]] employed by the [[One Sith]] around [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. He claimed to be able see the ''[[daen nosi]]'', the "Lines of Fate," and was convinced that they contained a pattern which he came close to understanding when he fed on the [[Soup (Anzati)|soup]] of enlightened beings.

After centuries of feeding, Kell Douro believed that only by feeding on a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] could the fabric of Fate be revealed to him. One such Jedi was [[Jaden Korr]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Name the Jedi you have encountered.''"<br />"''Jaden Korr.''"<br />"''We know of him. He was apprenticed to Katarn and is, therefore, dangerous.|Kell Douro updates [[Darth Wyyrlok (I)|Darth Wyyrlok]] on his pursuit of [[Jaden Korr]]|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
Centuries old and a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]<ref name="TFN">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30742136|board=Literature|thread=Paul S. Kemp Q&A Thread (Crosscurrent spoilers)|user=[[Paul S. Kemp|PaulsKemp]]|date=2010-02-05|time=1:20 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160526223024/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/paul-s-kemp-q-a-thread-crosscurrent-spoilers.30739715/page-2}}</ref> [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]], Kell Douro was trained as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. Kell captured beings that he held in his ship and later used as food, consuming their brain matter that he referred to as their "[[Soup (Anzati)|soup]]." Kell had performed services for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and decades later in [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], he often worked for the [[One Sith]], and was once more called to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] where he was met by [[Darth Wyyrlok (I)|Darth Wyyrlok I]]. Wyyrlok ordered Kell to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]], wait for a sign and report back to the Sith. Wyyrlok also strongly hinted that Kell might find the "enlightened being" he was searching for on Fhost.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

[[File:Crosscurrent_by_Chris_Scalf.jpg|thumb|250px|Douro attempts to feed on Jaden Korr.]]
Once in the [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole cantina]] on Fhost, Kell saw [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] and noticed that his Fate lines were entangled with his own. Convinced that it was his destiny to find revelation by consuming Jaden's soup, the Anzat secretly followed the Jedi, who was on his own search for revelation. Kell tracked Korr to a secret cloning lab on a [[Frozen moon]], the location of which was his actual objective. There, he encountered [[Khedryn Faal]], who had brought Jaden there. Moments before killing Faal, he decided that he would feed on no one but Jaden Korr, Kell left Faal wounded and unarmed in the upper level research lab. In the lower level he found Jaden Korr, exhausted from his fight with a [[Alpha (clone)|mad clone]] of [[Kam Solusar]], unable to resist the Anzat. Preparing to feed on Korr's soup, Kell suddenly saw his own silver ''daen nosi'' coming to an abrupt end rather than consuming the Jedi's. Faal had armed himself with a [[E-11b blaster rifle|E-11]] and shot Kell in the head, killing the Anzat instantly.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
Kell Duoro owned two [[Cortosis/Legends|Cortosis]]-coated [[Vibroblade/Legends|Vibroblades]] and had a [[Mimetic suit/Legends|Mimetic suit]] he used to sneak up on targets. He flew a heavily modified [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]], [[Predator (Kell Douro's ship)|''Predator'']] with a [[hyperdrive sled]] and stasis containers to store to feed on in space.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Thank you.''"<br />"''Thank you? Frag you!|Kell Douro to Khedryn Faal before the latter shot him in the head|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
Kell Douro was created by [[Paul S. Kemp]] for his novel ''[[Crosscurrent]]''.

Kell's perception of the ''daen nosi'' was similar to [[Jax Pavan]]'s perception
of the Force. However, this may be purely coincidence.

Though Anzati usually lacked hearts, it is stated in ''Crosscurrent'' that he had two hearts.
